grades: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders)
name: Summer Residential Governor's School for Visual & Performing Arts and Humanities
org: Radford University and the Virginia Department of Education
what_you_do: A summer residential program in Radford for visual and performing arts and humanities. The $300 activity fee covers outings, enrichment activities and field trips.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders) enrolled in Virginia high schools. Starts at your local school district.
pay_detail: $300 activity fee for outings and enrichment. Hardship waiver available. Tuition not stated on the pages read.
duration: Summer residential session (dates not stated on the pages read)
deadline_text: Dates and deadline for the next session were not found on the pages read. Ask your school counselor.
how_to_apply: The application starts at the local school district level. Application forms and guides are on the Virginia Department of Education Summer Residential Governor's School page. Admitted students register on SchoolDoc.
notes: Email rugovschool@radford.edu. The Virginia Department of Education page blocked our reader, so check it for current dates and forms.
